newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch police find missing German girls, arrest man.
newsitem.headline: Dutch police find missing German girls, arrest man.

text.p: Dutch police said on Friday they had found four missing German children and arrested a man suspected of abducting them.
The four, all girls aged 10 to 12, were found in the south western Dutch town of Oostburg, a police spokesman said.
"We have found the children and are holding a foreign man," a police spokesman in Oostburg said.
The children were reported missing in Cologne on Wednesday after failing to return home from a playground.
Dutch news agency ANP said the man being held was a 45-year-old German and was former lover of the mother of two of the girls, twins aged 12.
